spec_case: issue #778 step 7, H2 (an invalid Retry-After value is ignored; the normal backoff applies instead)
description: A 503 carries Retry-After: inf (RFC 9110 §10.2.3 explicitly calls this out as an invalid, ignorable form -- a sign, a fraction, inf/nan, internal whitespace, or an unparseable date). The parser must ignore it entirely rather than crash or saturate; the step retries with the normal exponential backoff and succeeds on the second attempt (meta.retries_used: 1).
